query:
SELECT 
  ah.id,
  ah.step,
  ah.action,
  ah.userName,
  ah.comment,
  ah.createdAt
FROM approvalHistory ah
JOIN purchaseRequests pr ON pr.id = ah.requestId
WHERE pr.requestNumber = 'SOL-2026-0157'
ORDER BY ah.id ASC;
